benefits.name: Annual Capital One Travel Credit
benefits.description: $300 statement credit for bookings made through Capital One Travel.
benefits.terms: Applies to bookings made through the Capital One Travel portal, per cardmember year.

benefits.name: Anniversary Bonus Miles
benefits.description: 10,000 bonus miles awarded every account anniversary.
benefits.terms: 10,000 miles (~$100 value) credited each account anniversary.

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck Credit
benefits.description: Statement credit for a Global Entry or TSA PreCheck application fee.
benefits.terms: One statement credit per account every four years, up to $120, credited within two billing cycles.

benefits.name: Premier Collection Hotel Credit
benefits.description: $100 experience credit on qualifying stays at Premier Collection hotels booked through Capital One Travel.

eligibleMerchants: Premier Collection via Capital One Travel

benefits.terms: Applied per qualifying Premier Collection stay booked through Capital One Travel.

benefits.name: Airport Lounge Access
benefits.description: Complimentary primary cardholder access to Capital One Lounges, Capital One Landings, and Priority Pass lounges.

loungeAccessDetail.guestPolicy: As of Feb. 1, 2026, authorized users no longer get complimentary access (available for $125/year per card). Primary cardholder cannot bring complimentary guests into Priority Pass lounges ($35/guest); Capital One Lounge/Landing guests are complimentary only above $75,000 in annual spend, otherwise $45/adult or $25/child.

benefits.terms: Access subject to space availability, not guaranteed.

benefits.name: Hertz President's Circle Status
benefits.description: Complimentary top-tier Hertz Gold Plus Rewards President's Circle elite status.
benefits.terms: Requires one-time enrollment through the Capital One benefits portal. Grants widest vehicle selection, guaranteed car-class upgrades, and a dedicated service line.

benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Reimbursement for cell phone theft or damage when the monthly wireless bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: Up to $800 per claim, $1,600 per 12-month period, $50 deductible, max 2 claims per year.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver
benefits.description: Coverage for damage/theft on most rental cars when the rental is paid for with the card.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties on eligible purchases.
